# dreamrouter_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists the names the router answers for: static DNS records and devices' DNS names (dreamrouter_host), including ones not managed by Terraform. It is read-only: listing a record doesn't make the project manage it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every name the router answers for, including ones not managed by Terraform:
# static records and devices' DNS names (source = "host").
data "dreamrouter_dns_records" "all" {}

# Static records only.
data "dreamrouter_dns_records" "static" {
  static_only = true
}

# Only MX records for one name.
data "dreamrouter_dns_records" "mail" {
  type = "MX"
  name = "home.internal"
}

output "all_records" {
  value = [for r in data.dreamrouter_dns_records.all.records : "${r.type} ${r.name} -> ${r.value}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return records with exactly this name.
- `static_only` (Boolean) Only return static DNS records, not devices' DNS names. Defaults to false.
- `type` (String) Only return records of this type.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) Matching records, sorted by name, type and value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the record is served.
- `id` (String) The record's ID on the router.
- `mac` (String) For source "host", the device's MAC address; otherwise empty.
- `name` (String) Record name.
- `port` (Number) Port (SRV).
- `priority` (Number) Priority (MX, SRV).
- `source` (String) "static" for a static DNS record, or "host" for a device's DNS name (served like an A record; managed with dreamrouter_host).
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds; 0 means automatic.
- `type` (String) Record type.
- `value` (String) Record value.
- `weight` (Number) Weight (SRV).
